South Africa Deputy Police Chief Resigns Amid Charges

Shadrack Sibiya, South Africa's deputy police chief, has resigned after being charged with sexual offenses. He had previously denied allegations of grooming a 16-year-old and raping an 18-year-old. The charges also reportedly include corruption.
